name: Token
tagline: Puts a spending limit on every bot in your fleet
description: Running a crowd of assistants means paying for all of them at once, and the invoice rarely says which one was careless. This gives each persona its own allowance, keeps the skills it loads trimmed back to what the job needs, and raises overruns quietly instead of pinging you about every single call.
author: Solomon
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
